links.outcome: LLM diagnostic and treatment reasoning quality on real prostate cancer cases, vs MDT consensus
links.effect: Comprehensive scores 4.20-4.40 of 5; both LLMs competent but did not surpass expert MDT; performance declined with disease stage, lowest in mCRPC.
links.quote: Both LLMs demonstrate competent assistance potential for PCa outpatient management but do not surpass expert MDT judgment.

links.outcome: LLM performance by prompt language (Chinese vs English)
links.effect: Chinese: DeepSeek 4.40 ± 0.51 vs ChatGPT 4.25 ± 0.47 (P<0.001). English: ChatGPT 4.33 ± 0.38 vs DeepSeek 4.20 ± 0.49 (P<0.001).
links.quote: In the English environment, ChatGPT-5.2 outperformed DeepSeek-V3.2 (4.33 ± 0.38 vs. 4.20 ± 0.49, P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter study evaluating diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning performance and multilingual adaptability of DeepSeek-V3.2 and ChatGPT-5.2 on prostate cancer cases compared to MDT consensus, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
